annotations.title: Add a stay to a group

description: Changes: moves one stay onto a group: who pays its room, its rate if rate is group, one more held room if grow_block; after the cut-off the company's Sales is e-mailed. Previews first: the first call shows the change and makes nothing. Puts an existing stay on an existing group. First call without confirm: a preview — the stay, its folio and the group folio before and after; nothing changes. Show it to the owner; to go ahead, call again with the same values, confirm true and preview_id. billing: group (the group folio pays the room) or own (the guest's own folio) — it must match how the group bills. rate: group (the group's rate) or keep (the stay's own rate). The group's rooms of that type all taken: grow_block true holds one more. After the cut-off: reason. Owner only. Needs the owner's sign-in.

billing.description: Who pays the room: the group folio, or the guest's own folio

confirm.description: true to make the change shown in the preview

grow_block.description: true to hold one more room of this type on the group when it has none left

rate.description: The group's rate, or keep the stay's own rate

reason.description: Why, in the owner's words; needed after the group's cut-off

name: add_stay_to_group
title: Add a stay to a group
